proposed statement: The client's current system has receptionists burning out due to high call volumes and double bookings
key statement: Fewer missed calls, no double bookings and fewer no-shows; the phones are the top priority, because the receptionists are burning out.

proposed statement: The project should allow pet owners to book appointments online via a website
key statement: A pet owner books on a website from their phone: chooses the clinic and the reason (vaccination, check-up, sick pet), sees open times and books one, then gets a reminder the day before.
